entries.claim: A hit qualifies when the projectile's impact or explosion rating plus the weapon's modifier reaches the destructible's shield (at it qualifies); its damage is read at the target's bounds midpoint -- a round's full to Effective_Range from the shot's start, then linear to 0 at Maximum_Range; the shield again on that rating (strictly); x14; the armour step with the round's Piercing (A x (10 - P) / 10 off the damage, a quarter of what it took off the armour); the health floored at 0 -- and at health 0 or below after the hit, whatever it was before, the animation's sequences run once; a round stops at the first qualifying surface.

entries.claim: Every draw of the world walk writes depth, blended packets included (ZBUF_1 ZMSK 0 for the walk), and the water's passes test it (ZTE 1, ZTST GEQUAL): a slope drawn by blended packets alone hides the water behind it in either draw order -- in three's order too (NU-15 B1, the cited interim; the engine order as the default is the owner's, W1.R3). The alpha pass, the shadow decals and the env and detail passes write none.
entries.source: FUN_00339de0 -> FUN_003b7150(0) D:L236792; FUN_003b7150 D:L308483-308488 -> FUN_003afe70 D:L304682-304710; the ELF's ZBUF packets 0x3e1180 (ZMSK 0) and 0x3e1140 (ZMSK 1); research 26 s3.2 (TEST_1 0x5000c)

MP71: every walk draw writes depth in three's order; every env and detail pass writes none and tests less-or-equal
